de1.P3.C3.explanation: Goc o tam bang 120 do (anh image105.png). Dien tich mot mat: $S = \frac{120}{360} \pi (30^2 - 10^2) = \frac{800\pi}{3}$ (cm$^2$). Dan ca hai mat: $S = \frac{1600\pi}{3} \approx 1675,52$ (cm$^2$).
de1.P3.C3.ly_do: Anh image105.png cho goc o tam 120 do, ban kinh 30 cm va 10 cm. Dien tich dung hai mat la 1600 pi / 3 xap xi 1675,52. Loi giai cu gia thiet goc 90 do (400 pi) va dap an luu 445,06 deu sai.

de1.P4.C4.ghi_chu: Y a kiem chung dung. Y b SAI nhu dang luu: voi R = 1, A = (-1;0), M = (-1;2) thi MC^2 = 4 nhung MK . MA xap xi 2,11; khung dien cung sai goc: goc MCK = goc CAH xap xi 31,7 do (goc tao boi tiep tuyen va day cung), khong phai goc MAC xap xi 63,4 do, nen tam giac MCK dong dang tam giac MAC khong dung. Y c SAI: D la trung diem cung AB nen E trung O, S_ADE = R^2 / 2 khong phu thuoc a; dap an a^2 / 4 chi dung khi a^2 = 2R^2, va cac phuong an khong chua R^2 / 2. Can de goc/thay quyet.
